description: Polyphonic wavetable oscillator from Surge, with two interpolation algorithms and a browser over the wavetables shipped with the plugin and any of your own in the Surge documents folder.

params.text: Scales both outputs, from silence to unity gain.
Sets the base pitch as a MIDI note from 1 to 127, with 60 giving middle C at 261.63Hz.
Switches the pitch between a note name with the knob snapped to whole semitones, and a frequency in Hz with the knob free between them.
Sets Morph, sweeping through the frames of the loaded wavetable, 0 to 100%, with both algorithms.
Sets Skew Vertical with the Wavetable algorithm and Formant with the Window algorithm.
Sets Saturate with the Wavetable algorithm, and with the Window algorithm picks the window shape: Triangle, Cosine, three Blends, Sawtooth, Sine, Square or Rectangle.
Sets Formant with the Wavetable algorithm and the Low Cut filter with the Window algorithm.
Sets Skew Horizontal with the Wavetable algorithm and the High Cut filter with the Window algorithm.
Sets Unison Detune, how far the stacked voices are detuned from each other, 0 to 100 cents, with both algorithms.
Sets Unison Voices, how many voices are stacked, 1 to 16, with both algorithms.
Steps through the wavetable categories; the oscillator carries on playing the loaded wavetable until Load is pressed.
Steps through the wavetables in the browsed category; the oscillator carries on playing the loaded wavetable until Load is pressed.
Loads the browsed wavetable into the oscillator. A red lamp is lit whenever the browsed wavetable differs from the one playing.
Picks the interpolation algorithm: Wavetable plays the frames through a model of an early digital converter, Window interpolates between them through a chosen window shape.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; with either algorithm, the parameter it belongs to is not one that can be switched off.
Turns on the Low Cut filter of the Window algorithm; with the Wavetable algorithm it does nothing.
Turns on the High Cut filter of the Window algorithm; with the Wavetable algorithm it does nothing.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; with either algorithm, the parameter it belongs to has no wider range to extend into.
Widens the range of Unison Detune from 100 cents out to 1200 cents.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, one volt per octave added to the Pitch knob; the number of channels here sets the polyphony.
Modulates Morph, adding a tenth of its full range per volt.
Modulates Skew Vertical or Formant depending on the algorithm, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Saturate or the window shape depending on the algorithm, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Formant or the Low Cut filter depending on the algorithm, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Skew Horizontal or the High Cut filter depending on the algorithm, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Unison Detune, adding a tenth of its full range per volt.
Modulates Unison Voices, adding a tenth of its full range per volt.

outputs.text: The left output; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.

notes: the wavetables are the set shipped inside the plugin folder, in the categories Basic, Generated, Oneshot, Rhythmic, Sampled and Waldorf; one is loaded when the module is placed.
the oscillator runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
